Problem Statement:
Create a custom comparator using a lambda expression to sort a list of Person objects based on their age and then by their name in alphabetical order. You are given a list of Person objects, where each Person has a name (String) and an age (int). Write a program that sorts the list first by age in descending order. If two people have the same age, sort them by their name in ascending order. Implement this using a lambda expression with a custom comparator. 
Input Description:
The first line contains an integer n, the number of Person objects. The next n lines each contain two values: a name (String) and age (int) of a Person. 
Output Description:
Print the sorted list of Person objects in the specified order. 
Sample Input:
5
Alice 30
Bob 25
Charlie 30
Dave 22
Eve 25 
Sample Output:
Alice 30
Charlie 30
Bob 25
Eve 25
Dave 22
